chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, and a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Ibn Mahboub, from Jameel ibn Salih, from Abu Baseer, who said:

I heard a man saying to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): 'May I be your ransom! I am a man who has aged, and I have married a young virgin woman, and I have not yet entered with her, and I fear that when she comes to me, she will see me and dislike me due to my dyeing and my old age.'

So Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'When she comes, instruct her before she reaches you that she should be in ablution. Then you do not reach her until you have performed ablution and prayed two cycles. Then glorify Allah, and send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. Then supplicate, and instruct those who are with her to say Ameen to your supplication, and say: O Allah! Grant me her affection, her love, and her pleasure, and make me pleased with her, and gather us together with the best of gatherings and the most comforting of unions, for You love the permissible and dislike the forbidden.'
Then he (peace be upon him) said: 'And know that the affection is from Allah, and the separation is from Satan, to make disliked what Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has permitted.'
ai.seo_question: What are the recommended spiritual and physical preparations for marital intimacy according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith addresses the psychological anxiety of an older husband regarding his young, virgin wife, offering a spiritual remedy through ritual purity (wudu) and specific supplications (dua) to foster mutual affection (ilf). The Imam’s instruction to pray two cycles before intimacy highlights the Shia emphasis on transforming physical union into an act of worship, while the concluding distinction between 'ilf' (affection from God) and 'firak' (discord from Satan) underscores the metaphysical source of marital harmony. This guidance remains central to Shia family jurisprudence for maintaining emotional and spiritual connection in marriage.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, and a number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Ibn Mahboub, from Jameel Bin Salih, from Abu Baseer who said,

‘I heard a man and he was saying to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! I am a man who had aged, and have married a young virgin woman and have not slept with her, and I fear that when she comes over to me, she would see me and dislike me due to my dyeing, and my old age’.

Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When she comes over, so instruct her before she arrives to you that she should be in ablution. Then you should not go to her until you have performed ablution and Prayed two Cycles. Then you Glorify Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and send Blessings upon Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and the Progeny<sup>asws</sup> of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>. Then supplicate and instruct the ones who are with her that they should say Ameen upon your supplication, and say, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Grace me her kindness, and her cordiality, and her pleasure, and Make me to be pleased with her, and gather us together with the best of the gatherings, with kindly love, for You<sup>azwj</sup> Love the Permissible and Dislike the Prohibited’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And know that the kindness is from Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and the separation is from the Satan<sup>la</sup> disliking what Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic has Permitted’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa and A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘ Abd Allah from ibn Mahbub from Jamil ibn Salih from abu Basir who has said the following:

“I heard a man saying to abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, I am an aged man. I have married a virgin young woman. I have not gone to bed with her as yet. I am afraid in bed on finding me of such age and the dye on my beard she may dislike me.’

Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ’When you are there ask her before approaching you to take Wudu’. You also should not approach her before taking Wudu’ and performing two Rak’at Salat (prayer). Thereafter, speak of the glory of Allah and say, “Allahumma Salli ‘Ala Muhammad xva ‘Ali Muhammad (O Allah grant Muhammad and his family a compensation worthy of their serving Your cause).” Thereafter ask her and others present with her to say A’min (O Allah grant his wishes). Thereafter say, ‘O Lord, provide her enough reasons to be kind to me, love me, be happy with me, grant me enough reason to be happy with her, bring us together in the best form of gathering, and the happiest kindness; You love what is lawful and dislike unlawful matters.’
The Imam then said, ‘You must bear in mind that kindness comes from Allah and hate comes from Satan so that people clash and dislike what Allah has made lawful.’”
